# Pellorn

> Enterprise AI Security Posture Management dashboard for Canadian financial institutions. Real-time monitoring, red-team sandboxing, and compliance reporting for autonomous AI agents in production.

Pellorn gives security and compliance teams a unified gateway to observe, audit, and govern AI agents against frameworks including OSFI E-21, PIPEDA, AIDA, and SOC 2 Type II.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Live threat feed, policy enforcement, red-team sandbox, model inventory, vulnerability audit, behavioral drift, board report, and diagnostics.
